note: Every trace is the candidate production wiring for the control family. Demo implementations simulate at the state-mutation step and always receipt as simulated; no concept-only state masquerades as production wiring.

families.trace: UI source → cmd.settings.navigate (or category/subcategory/setting.focus, manager.open) → Settings owner → target validation against the registry → route state mutation (hash + history) → route-change event → workspace/manager projection with focus settle → Usage: none; diagnostics record the deep link → recovery: Back/forward restores the previous route

UI source → cmd.settings.value.set → settings inventory owner → schema validation + managed-policy permission (managed/unavailable refuse) → persistent value mutation with scope → value-changed event + receipt → row re-projection with resolved state badge → Usage: none; diagnostics log the change → recovery: cmd.settings.default.restore + deep link to the row

UI source → cmd.settings.value.set → inventory owner → field validator (absolute .exe path) → refusal leaves the stored value untouched and raises the row error slot → error event → row re-projection with role=alert → diagnostics attribute the failed attempt → recovery: correct the value or clear for Auto

UI source → cmd.account.select_profile / cmd.provider.switch_route (both reused canon IDs) → Multi-Account / Models System owner → permission check → connection state mutation → account-changed event + receipt ('future requests only') → accounts tab re-projection → Usage attribution follows the new account on subsequent work → recovery: re-select the previous account; deep link to the accounts tab

UI source → cmd.provider.installation.* → Binary Locator / Release owner → ownership-confidence + policy validation (unknown owner is manual-only; idle-auto needs proven ownership) → installation/update state machine mutation → ObservableWork phases (updating → verifying) + receipts → Installation tab re-projection → diagnostics log each phase → recovery: cmd.provider.installation.rollback returns to the last verified version; deep link to the tab

UI source → cmd.provider.catalog.refresh (alias of cmd.model.refresh) → Models System → coalesced refresh permission → catalog version mutation with last-known-good retained → refresh events + receipt → models tab re-projection with timestamp → Usage: one probe-sized request when probes are on → recovery: last-known-good list never leaves the screen

UI source → cmd.memory.* → Assistant Memory owner → review-policy validation → gist mutation (status/pin/text/version) → memory-changed event + receipt → ledger re-projection with activation bar → Usage: none (retrieval only) → recovery: version restore; deleted gists keep evidence in the receipt

UI source → cmd.persona.manage (alias over the canon persona verbs) / cmd.crew.template.update → Personas / Orchestrator owner → trust + injection-scan validation on import → template/default mutation → event + receipt → gallery/card re-projection → Usage attribution stays on the role routes → recovery: cancel import; strict policy restore

UI source → cmd.permissions.rule.reorder (alias cmd.permissions.reorder_rule) / cmd.permissions.rule.test → Permissions owner → order mutation or dry evaluation → rule-trace event → ordered list re-projection with last-match-wins trace → diagnostics record the trace sample → recovery: reorder back; presets receipt before apply

UI source → cmd.settings.value.set (goal.bsd-mode) → Goal Runtime owner → bounded-delta privacy validation → mode mutation → event + receipt → BSD manager re-projection with health → Usage attribution per review → recovery: set Auto; a failed review never blocks primary work
